snippet.title: Lets Catch
snippet.description:
ESRB Rating: EVERYONE with Comic Mischief and Mild Suggestive Themes

In LETS CATCH players will experience a new twist on the game of catch in six different single and multiplayer modes to play. Excelling through good timing and hand-eye coordination, players will find themselves playing games that range from having players pass a bomb to other players before it explodes, test players ability to catch a fast ball, challenge players throwing accuracy and more. 

LET'S CATCH is available for download now from the Nintendo Channel store.
